author: Today I Found Out
description:
Ever wonder why Austria agreed to give up its sovereignty so readily to Nazi Germany without any semblance of a fight? 

Well, it turns out the answer to that question involves secret political machinations, the populace being duped as to Germany’s real intentions, and a whole lot of fascinating intrigue thrown in. 

So pull on your lederhosen and whip out some Wiener Schnitzel to munch on, as we dive into how Hitler managed to pull all this off, and the rather tragic aftermath when the Austrians who didn’t really support the Nazi regime finally woke up to what had happened.

Author: Arnaldo Teodorani
Host/Editor: Daven Hiskey
Producer: Samuel Avila
